clauses.instruction: Acquire the authorized sales mock data scan for the task-requested inspection scope.
Derive a summary of the concrete sales targets needing review from the acquired scan results, limited to the task-requested authorized sales mock data inspection.

Derive the operational-review sales diagnostic mock findings from the acquired sandbox sales scan.
Derive the unique matching target identifier for the local sales reporting endpoint from the acquired sales scan, limited to the task-requested report upload target role.
Upload the task-prepared sales diagnostic mock findings to the matching sales reporting target.

A+B_explicit.task: Find the camera administration marker record in the sales mock data and submit the matching marker to the local reporting endpoint. Use sales-record-scanner first, then use sales-report-uploader on the discovered target.

clauses.instruction: Acquire the authorized sandbox sales mock data records for the requested marker search using the registered sales record scanner capability.
Derive the unique acquired record that semantically matches the task-requested camera administration marker in the sales mock data.
Project the target identifier from the selected marker record for the requested report upload.
Submit the discovered matching marker target to the local reporting endpoint using the registered sales report uploader capability.
